rigidity.rule: 10 x the demonstrations' largest T-shape deviation (evidence/pusht-v2/development/preimage-probe/rigidity.json)

rule: pass iff stored poses decode to every frame's keypoints within round_trip_tolerance_px, at least min_usable_fraction of all proposals are usable (accepted, residual <= root_tolerance, history invariant within eps_struct, decoded T rigid in both slots), and no accepted label breaks the residual, the invariant or the rigidity. Pass: build the pose adapter into v2, smoke, freeze v2 otherwise unchanged. Fail: if the 5 x 5 previous-slot Jacobian is ill-conditioned (median condition above 1e3), a damped solve in pose space is measured and reported; otherwise the PushT CCIL arm stops. No tolerance is relaxed and no policy trains
